description: This file defines a WorkerPool class managing a pool of web workers, including creation, message posting, and cleanup logic.

classes.name: IdleWorker
classes.description: Represents an individual web worker instance with a debounce termination method.

classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of web workers, handling creation, message passing, and cleanup.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new WorkerPool instance with specified URL and options.

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to a worker, creating one if necessary, and returns a promise with the response.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Terminates all idle workers in the pool.

methods.name: createWorker
methods.description: Creates a new IdleWorker instance and sets up debounce termination.

methods.name: onMessageHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from workers, resolving the promise and recycling the worker.

methods.name: onErrorHandler
methods.description: Handles worker errors, terminates the worker, and clears the pool.
